title: Introducing Close Forms: Capture Leads Instantly, Close Deals Faster
summary: Capture website leads instantly with Close Forms. No third-party tools, no delays—just fast, clean lead flow built directly into Close.
body_markdown:
Ask any sales manager what moves the needle in an inbound sales motion, and they’ll say the same thing every time: speed.


But for too many teams,[speed to lead](https://www.close.com/blog/how-to-reach-out-to-leads-fast) is slowed down by clunky form tools, Zapier chains, and integrations that break at the worst times. Every delay—every sync issue, every misfire—means a colder lead and a missed opportunity.


Plus, the additional costs and headache of a separate form tool you have to[integrate with your CRM](https://www.close.com/integrations) ? Not great.


That changes *today* .


Meet **Close Forms** : the fastest, simplest way to capture website leads directly into Close so your team can follow up immediately. No third-party tools. No delays. No lost leads. No extra costs.


Just instant, clean lead flow and instant follow-up power. **Free on all**[Close plans](https://www.close.com/pricing) **.**


## **A No-Code Form Builder, Built Right Into Close**


With Forms now baked into your CRM, you can:


- **Reach your leads** in minutes, not days
- Build **customizable** forms in a few clicks, no coding required
- [Embed](https://www.close.com/blog/embedding-images-in-emails) them anywhere on your website via HTML
- Instantly create new leads or update existing ones on submission
- Get automatic email notifications
- **Filter and organize** form-driven leads with Smart Views
- Use hidden fields for attribution and tracking
- [Keep data clean](https://www.close.com/blog/data-hygiene-for-crm) with built-in **spam protection**
- Ensure **compliance** with easy checkboxes


Close Forms gives you the fastest path from website visits → full pipeline.


## **Bye Bye, Third-Parties, Zaps, and Extra Costs 👋🏼**


Save money and avoid potential mistakes when you switch. Forms cuts these from your brainspace:


- Additional form tools or paid integrations
- Field-mapping hassles and errors
- Sync delays and slow lead follow-ups
- [Workflow](https://www.close.com/blog/automate-follow-ups-with-close-workflows) and integration troubleshooting


Everything just works—right where your team already sells.


## **Available Now**


Close Forms is now live for all customers, free of usage or add-on costs.


If you’re ready to increase your speed to lead, start here.


[Try Close Forms now](https://app.close.com/signup)
